title: tenant-overview/platform-overview dashboards no longer show "undefined" tiles; both converted to declarative dashboard screens (fw#2312).
detail: Both overview screens sent `totalCount: true` to `tenant:query:list`/`jobs:query:list`, but neither handler's Zod schema declared the field, so it was stripped before the handler saw it and the tile rendered the literal string "undefined". Both handlers now accept `totalCount: boolean` and return `total` when set — `jobs:query:list`'s total is a real count (via `countWhere`), not `rows.length`, so it isn't capped by `limit`. `config:query:readiness` gains `missingCount`/`missingTone` alongside the existing `missing` array. `PlatformOverviewScreen`/`TenantOverviewScreen` (never public exports) and their `overview-layout`/`overview-query` support modules are gone — both screens are now `type: "dashboard"` (`kind: "stat"` panels) rendered by the generic renderer, using the new `DashboardStatPanel.params` (see framework changelog) to pin the failed-jobs tile's `status: "failed"` filter server-side. The `overview-allowlist` exports (`isOverviewQueryAllowed`, `overviewAllowedQueries`, the allow/forbidden-list constants) are unchanged and still importable — they're now checked against the screen definitions in tests instead of gating a deleted client-side dispatch call.

title: admin-shell: neues bundled-feature für rollen-gated Tenant- und Platform-Workspaces mit O…
detail: admin-shell: neues bundled-feature für rollen-gated Tenant- und Platform-Workspaces mit Overview-Home-Screens, Nav-Icons und Server-i18n. Komponiert Screens aus `tenant`, `audit`, `jobs` und optional `tier-engine` — mount nach diesen Features. Overview-Queries laufen über eine fest kodierte Allowlist pro Workspace, um versehentliche Cross-Workspace-Datenzugriffe zu verhindern.
